info.name: FullStory Segments Export Batch Import API
Create a batch user import job

items.docs: Imports up to 50,000 users in a single asynchronous request. Returns a job object with an ID and status that can be polled for completion. Users can be anonymous or identified with a uid.

info.name: Create a batch events import job

items.docs: Imports a large number of events in a single asynchronous request. Returns a job object with an ID and status that can be polled for completion. Each event in the batch can include custom properties and session associations.
